t: The Output Port allows you to extract the fluid fuel from the Fluidizer.$(br2)You can connect a pipe of any sort to extract the fuel automatically.
输出端口可以让你从流化器中提取流体燃料。$(br2)你可以连接任意类型的管道来自动提取燃料。
$(l)Mandatory:$() at least one is required$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() no
$(l)必需：$()至少需要一个$(br)$(l)有效位置：$()任意面上（不在框架上）$(br)$(l)图形界面：$()否
